cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: The Approved Explanation
cards.instruction: Protect someone or the group by maintaining a simplified account that everyone can safely repeat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Tell the children the trip's postponed for bus repairs. They'll worry about Mr Patel. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's fine. His parked bus rolled into the pond.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then everyone says, 'Mr Patel is fine; the bus needs repairs.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The parents will ask whether he was driving.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then 'The parked bus needs repairs; Mr Patel is fine.' Same sentence for the office. We don't need three versions of his afternoon.

mechanism: A coordinates a reassuring trip account, changes its wording for B factual objections and takes part of the communication work.
confusable: Unlike hiding all evidence, A includes the parked bus and the unharmed person in a simple repeatable account.
comparison: School trip office and parents differ from a birthday speech protecting a relative embarrassment.
seedUse: D183-a Mr Patel and parked bus; S02-a negotiates the shared sentence and divides calls.
